# Godot AI Enhanced

## Overview
Godot AI Enhanced is a Python FastAPI sidecar that extends Godot Engine 4.3-stable with advanced AI capabilities. It provides:
- Dynamic NPC dialogue with persistent memory and personalities (powered by LLMs)
- Procedural level generation with AI-created textures
- Neural asset upscaling and voice synthesis
- Continuous research integration for self-improvement

## Features
### 🧠 NPC Brain
- LLM-powered dialogue (Claude/GPT/Ollama) with personality profiles
- Persistent long-term memory using FAISS and SQLite
- Emotion classification for contextual responses
- Optional voice synthesis with Bark TTS

### 🏗️ Procedural Generation
- AI-generated room layouts from text descriptions
- Stable Diffusion XL texture synthesis
- CLIP-based relevance filtering
- NetworkX graph validation for connectivity

### ⚡ Asset Enhancement
- Real-ESRGAN 4x/8x neural upscaling
- Tile-based processing for large images
- MD5 hash caching to avoid reprocessing
- Bark TTS for NPC voice lines

### Research Advisor
- Daily ArXiv cs.AI + cs.GR crawling
- Semantic Scholar and Papers with Code integration
- Automated research proposal generation
- SECOND-KNOWLEDGE-BRAIN.md knowledge base += @"

## Usage
### From GDScript
Use the provided Godot plugin (ddons/godot_ai/GodotAIClient.gd):

# Load the plugin
var ai_client = preload("res://addons/godot_ai/GodotAIClient.gd").new()

# NPC dialogue
var response = ai_client.request_npc_dialogue("innkeeper_mira", "What quests do you have?")
print(response.reply)  # LLM-generated response

# Asset enhancement
var enhanced = ai_client.enhance_asset("res://textures/stone.png", scale=4)
# Returns enhanced texture path

# Level generation
var level = ai_client.generate_level("A dark goblin cave with treasure", "cave", "dark fantasy")
# Returns layout JSON and textures

### API Endpoints
All endpoints are available at http://localhost:7890/api/v1/:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| /npc/dialogue | POST | Generate NPC dialogue |
| /npc/profile | GET/POST | Manage NPC profiles |
| /level/generate | POST | Create procedural level |
| /asset/enhance | POST | Upscale images |
| /asset/voice | POST | Synthesize voice |
| /research/proposals | GET | Get research proposals |
| /knowledge/update | POST | Trigger knowledge crawl |
| /health | GET | Health check |
## Model Information
| Task | Model | Source |
|------|-------|--------|
| Upscaling | ai-forever/Real-ESRGAN | HuggingFace |
| Voice | suno/bark | HuggingFace |
| Textures | stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 | HuggingFace |
| Embeddings | sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 | HuggingFace |
| Emotion | j-hartmann/emotion-english-distilroberta-base | HuggingFace |
| LLM (Primary) | Claude 3 Opus | Anthropic |
| LLM (Fallback) | GPT-4o / Llama3 | OpenAI / Ollama |
